item.description:
Hey there!

Thanks for checking out my website. I am a researcher and public interest technologist interested in finding ways to leverage technology to build participatory solutions that improve outcomes for vulnerable populations.

I also love to go on outdoor adventures, read, and pursue a number of nerdy hobbies. You can find my professional details, contact information, what I’m currently up to (with a slight lag). Some stuff to check out while you are here:
